operator_direction: Real observation inputs and targets; ERA5 only for separate verification. R2 service disabled; preserve cache.
hypothesis: More geographically distributed observations and a full seasonal cycle reduce analysis and forecast error relative to the small R1 pilot.
selection: epoch_by_validation_only; no hyperparameter selection on test
scientific_limits: R2 changes several factors and is a scale experiment, not a causal ablation.
Station availability and quality determine whether 1024 stations can be admitted.
Six-hour issue windows overlap within each split and are not independent weather episodes.
Split boundaries retain 84-hour guards; final test uses a new period after R1.
Historical arrival times are assumed, not observed.
ERA5 supplies targets, not missing input observations.
Satellite channels remain quarantined until physical admission.
No independent numerical-weather baseline or scientific acceptance is claimed.
modernization_stages: R2: enlarge validated station limits, stream prepared observation files, run full-year training.
R3: diagnose initial-analysis error, normalization, coverage and error by region and pressure.
R4: bounded validation-only search over learning rate, width and latent slots; shared source archive.
R5: admit profiles and calibrated satellites, repeat finalists with multiple seeds and a new test period.
R6: implement and compare HEALPix candidate using common targets and measured resources.
